name: maxwell-model/Maxwell-V1-Flash model card
notes: Fetched 2026-11-17. Weights repo created 2026-10-13 (HF API createdAt 2026-10-13T07:53:39Z), 171,296 downloads and 79 likes at read time - a low-traffic launch card, not a trending spike. Nameplate: 35B total / 3B active MoE, text-only, 262,144 configured context (256K), Apache-2.0. HF safetensors total 36,810,559,422 BF16, which does not match the card's '35B excluding embeddings' claim - the difference is the 200,704-token embedding and the MTP layer, so params_b is recorded from safetensors and the card's 35B/3B split is recorded as the vendor's own figure. Four benchmark tables read by parsing the raw HTML <table> blocks: Table 1 base-vs-base pretraining comparison (Qwen3.0-w30a3-base, Qwen3.5-w35a3-base, Maxwell-V1.0-Flash-Base), Table 2 RULER base comparison, Table 3 the post-trained model against Qwen3.6 35B-A3B, Gemma-4 26B-A4B-it, Nemotron-3.5 Lightning and Muse Glimmer-30B, and Table 0 the spec sheet. All numbers are vendor claims; no third-party reproduction was found. The card prints per-benchmark settings in prose after the tables: temperature 0.6 / top-p 0.95 / top-k 20, 32K context, AA-LCR + math + HLE at 128K, science at 80K, LiveCodeBench v6 at 64K, SWE-Bench Verified via Claude Code harness 2.1.212 (256K context, 240 turns, 4h wall clock), Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harbor/Terminus-2 (2h timeout, 256K context, temp 1.0). Asterisked BrowseComp/HLE-with-tools/WideSearch/DeepSearchQA values are 'with context management enabled' and are recorded separately from the unasterisked value.
